name: MonitorMIDServer
title: MonitorMIDServer - Global
summary: The MonitorMIDServer script include provides methods to monitor MID Servers using the heartbeat probe to check for MID Servers that are down, sends heartbeat requests, and kills old heartbeat requests.
overview: Use this script include in a server script to monitor MID Servers.

members.name: killOldRequests
members.summary: If there are any heartbeat probe requests that haven't been processed, cancels them so that they don't accumulate when a MID server is down for a while.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
void 
var mmsv = new MonitorMIDServer();
mmsv.killOldRequests();

members.name: markDowners
members.summary: Marks any non-responding MID servers as being down, by determining when the most recent heartbeat was sent and finding all non-responding servers.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
void 
var mmsv = new MonitorMIDServer();
mmsv.markDowners();

members.name: monitor
members.summary: Performs the functions required for a scheduled MID server monitor cycle, including killing old requests, marking the MID servers that are down, and sending heartbeat requests to all servers.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
void 
var mmsv = new MonitorMIDServer();
mmsv.monitor();

members.name: sendHeartbeatRequests
members.summary: Sends heartbeat requests to all MID servers and notes when by updating the server status record.
